The family name “Sylvester” comes from the Latin word *silvestris*, meaning “wooded” or “wild.”  
During the time of Charlemagne, the Frankish king who later founded what would become the Holy Roman Empire, Latin was the official and literary language used in administration, law, and the Church. Thus the surname’s root language – Latin – was precisely the language in use during that era.
